g.title: INT. LIGHTHOUSE, THE LAMP ROOM - NIGHT. Maya and Theo by the dead lamp, in the dark. MAYA, off panel: Nobody had climbed those stairs in thirty years. KEEPER, off panel: Who's up there? MAYA, whispering: Don't answer him.
Theo at the window. Far below, a lantern swings on the path. THEO: He has a lantern. RADIO, off panel: ...harbour patrol, do you read... MAYA: Then he has oil.

INT. THE LAMP ROOM - LATER. Theo has gone. The keeper fills the doorway, his lantern raised. Off panel: Theo had gone for help. He took the long way. KEEPER: Thirty years. Who let you in? MAYA, off panel: I let myself in.
